Build provenance (does not alter the license above):
The supported source builder is scripts/build_glm_prefill/build.sh. It compiles
the NVIDIA sparse-MLA translation unit from the exact FlashInfer revision in
scripts/build_glm_prefill/sources.sh, plus the Atlas bridge sources. Preserve
FlashInfer and per-file NVIDIA notices with resulting binary distributions.
SOURCE_MAP.json retains the earlier cached-object provenance as historical
evidence only; the current source build neither requires nor uses that object.
Recipe attribution and imported-file hashes: third_party/glm_prefill/provenance.json.
